# @wirecat/cli-core — the foundation for agent-ready CLIs

The guide to this package is its [README](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-core#readme): output for
people and machines, stable exit codes, the keyring, testable clocks and the shared tooling. How it is
built and released is in [`docs/dev/`](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-core/tree/main/docs/dev).

This page is generated on every change to `main`, so an edit made here is overwritten. To fix it, open a
pull request against `.github/wiki/Home.md`.

Questions and ideas: [Discussions](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-core/discussions). What changed in
each version: [releases](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-core/releases). Install it with
`npm install @wirecat/cli-core`. cli-core is part of [WireCat](https://wirecat.dev).
